# Draft:Photosculpt Textures Software

----
PhotoSculpt Textures is a specialized software tool used to create high-resolution 3D textures and models from just two photographs of a subject taken from different angles. This software caters specifically to computer graphics artists by enabling them to generate fully textured 3D models and tileable textures for further use in various 3D applications.
History
* 2010: Release of PhotoSculpt Textures Software v1.0
* 2025: Release of PhotoSculpt Textures Software v2.04 under Open Source (Apache) license
Overview
* Release date: 2010-03-15
* Original web page: http://www.photosculpt.net (discontinued since 2019)
* Archive web page for reference: https://web.archive.org/web/20150610174911if_/http://photosculpt.net/)
* Source and binary executables : https://github.com/hipe-0/PhotoSculpt-Textures
* License: Open Source (Apache 2.0)
* Author: Hippolyte Mounier
* Platform: Windows 32 bits
* Output: 2.5D textures
* Exports: PNG, OBJ, STL
* Technology: Stereogrammetry using binocular vision for exporting textures
* Pricing (applied between 2010 and 2019): 99 € for v1 ; 139 € for v2. Now: free
Independent reviews
* Tested in: 3D World Magazine issue number 131, page 110 by Ed Ricketts, July 2010. - see [https://github.com/hipe-0/PhotoSculpt-Textures/blob/main/PrintedMedia/3DWorldMagazine131-Photosculpt-July2010.jpg photo]
* Tested in: 3D Mag issue number 6, 2010 - see [https://github.com/hipe-0/PhotoSculpt-Textures/blob/main/PrintedMedia/3DMagazine6-Article-Photosculpt-2010.jpg photo].
Exemple of texture outputs
Reviews
"[...] given we have a very extensive knowledge of all the texturing solutions out there, I can say with certainty that you already have a market-leading solution.  [...] really impressed so far and wish you all the best." Dave O. editor at CGenie.com, UK
"Very functional, and can definitely save a lot of time. If you where comfortable with, or not good at, texture creation in photoshop or mudbox/zbrush. Then this would be an invaluable piece of software, as it basically removes that whole element of the design process." Graeme Palmer, freelance 3d modeller, Scotland ()
Key Features
{| class="wikitable"
!Feature
!Description
|-
|3D Model Creation
|Generates detailed 3D models from two photos, providing depth and realism.
|-
|Texture Options
|Exports various texture types including normal, displacement, and ambient occlusion maps.
|-
|Tileable Textures
|Creates seamless textures that can be used in multiple environments without visible seams.
|-
|Export Formats
|Supports standard formats for exporting 3D models such as OBJ and STL.
|-
|User-Friendly Interface
|Designed with a straightforward layout, making it easy for users to create models and textures without complex setups.
|-
|High-Resolution Output
|Produces photorealistic, high-definition textures suitable for various applications.
|-
|Quick Processing
|Models are displayed rapidly during processing to enhance workflow efficiency.
|}
Demo texture packs for download
* 29 High-res textures can be downloaded here: https://archive.org/details/cdrom-3d-world-154
* Texture collection can be downloaded here: https://archive.org/details/cdrom-3d-world-137
